title: Count Substrings Starting and Ending with Given Character
summary: Given a string and a character, count all substrings that begin and end with the specified character.
statement: Given a string and a character, count all substrings that begin and end with the specified character.
constraints: Count nonempty substrings whose first and last characters both equal c.
Every occurrence of c forms a one-character substring.
hints: Only the positions containing c matter as endpoints.
Choose one occurrence twice for a singleton or two ordered-by-position distinct occurrences.
For m occurrences the count is m(m+1)/2.
Every valid substring corresponds uniquely to its endpoint occurrence pair.
editorial: Every valid substring corresponds uniquely to its endpoint occurrence pair.

tests.explanation: Three a positions give three singletons and three pairs of endpoints, totaling six.
With no a occurrence, no substring qualifies.
